title: Universal holonomic control of algebras of observables
summary: We extend geometric parallel transport from states and degenerate eigenspaces to observable algebras defining generalized quantum subsystems. At fixed block structure, unitary invariance fixes a unique connection, recovering Berry--Wilczek--Zee transport on bands. On positive-dimensional strata, its holonomy is the special-unitary part of the normalizer: all inner logical gates and equal-type sector permutations are attainable. Given a compatible gapped Hamiltonian and access to the required paths, inner gates can be implemented adiabatically by isospectral control of a band refinement.
